successCriteria.description: The `AuditLog` entity is defined and exported from `src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts` with exactly these fields: `id: string`, `entityType: string`, `entityId: string`, `action: string`, `oldValues: Record<string, unknown> | null`, `newValues: Record<string, unknown> | null`, `performedBy: string`, `performedAt: Date`

The `IAuditRepository` interface is defined and exported from `src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts` with exactly three methods: `create(entry: Omit<AuditLog, 'id' | 'performedAt'>): Promise<AuditLog>`, `findByEntity(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditLog[]>`, `findByPerformer(performedBy: string, limit?: number): Promise<AuditLog[]>`

`AuditRepository` class in `src/modules/audit/audit.repository.ts` implements `IAuditRepository` and uses the shared `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` for all database operations against the `audit_logs` table
`AuditRepository.create` generates a UUID for `id` via `crypto.randomUUID()`, auto-sets `performedAt` to `new Date()`, inserts a row into `audit_logs`, and returns the persisted `AuditLog`

`AuditService` class in `src/modules/audit/audit.service.ts` takes `IAuditRepository` via constructor injection and exposes three methods: `log(entry: Omit<AuditLog, 'id' | 'performedAt'>): Promise<AuditLog>`, `getEntityHistory(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditLog[]>`, `getUserActions(performedBy: string, limit?: number): Promise<AuditLog[]>`
`AuditService.log` delegates to `IAuditRepository.create` and returns the resulting `AuditLog` — it does not modify the entry beyond what the repository already does

constraints: All database access MUST go through the repository layer — `AuditService` must never call `pool` directly (GP-001, HARNESS.json `no-direct-db-outside-repository`)
No `any` type anywhere — use `Record<string, unknown>` for `oldValues`/`newValues` and `DbRow = Record<string, unknown>` for database row mapping (HARNESS.json `no-any`)
UUID generation MUST use Node 20's built-in `crypto.randomUUID()` — no external uuid package
All SQL queries MUST use parameterized placeholders (`$1`, `$2`, …) — never string interpolation or template concatenation
outOfScope: Barrel file (`src/modules/audit/index.ts`) — belongs to sibling sub-phase 4c
Unit and integration tests for the audit module — belong to sibling sub-phase 4c (`tests/unit/modules/audit/audit.service.spec.ts`)

entityInvariants.invariant: AuditLog records are immutable once created — no update or delete operations exist on the repository or service. The `id` and `performedAt` fields are always generated at creation time and never supplied by the caller.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must throw if the database insert fails (e.g., constraint violation, connection error). Must not silently swallow errors.
Returns empty array when no matching audit records exist — never null. Ordered by `performedAt` descending (most recent first).

Returns empty array when no matching audit records exist — never null. Ordered by `performedAt` descending. When `limit` is provided, returns at most that many rows; when omitted, returns all matching rows.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `AuditLog` entity's `action` field uses `string` type, but callers are expected to use values from the `AuditAction` enum defined in `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts`. The repository must not validate or restrict action values — it accepts any string.

The repository's `mapRow` helper must convert snake_case database columns (`entity_type`, `entity_id`, `old_values`, `new_values`, `performed_by`, `performed_at`) to camelCase `AuditLog` fields, following the same pattern used in `EmployeeRepository.mapRow` and `PolicyRepository.mapRow`
The `AuditService` constructor must accept `IAuditRepository` (the interface, not the concrete class), matching the dependency injection pattern used by `EmployeeService` and `PolicyService`

Module imports must use the `baseUrl` path resolution from `tsconfig.json` — e.g., `import { pool } from 'shared/db/connection'` and `import { AuditAction } from 'shared/types/leave.types'` — matching the import style of existing modules

integrationPoints.why: AuditRepository uses the shared pg.Pool for all database operations against the audit_logs table
